verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms docs.ramp.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200. Docs describe it as a machine-readable index with explicit agent usage instructions, per-guide plain-text exports, llms-full.txt, a plain-text API reference, an OpenAPI schema, and channel recommendations for agents. Ramp also ships an unauthenticated Developer MCP docs server, and agents.ramp.com offers a markdown alternate for machine readers.
